reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7493, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا كَلاَمَ اللَّهِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ بَيْنَمَا أَيُّوبُ يَغْتَسِلُ عُرْيَانًا خَرَّ عَلَيْهِ رِجْلُ جَرَادٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ فَجَعَلَ يَحْثِي فِي ثَوْبِهِ، فَنَادَى رَبُّهُ يَا أَيُّوبُ أَلَمْ أَكُنْ أَغْنَيْتُكَ عَمَّا تَرَى قَالَ بَلَى يَا رَبِّ وَلَكِنْ لاَ غِنَى بِي عَنْ بَرَكَتِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Abdullah ibn Muhammad narrated to us: Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us: Ma‘mar informed us, from Hammam, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet, who said, “While Ayyub was bathing naked, a swarm of golden locusts fell upon him, and he began gathering them into his garment. His Lord called to him, ‘O Ayyub, have I not made you independent of what you see?’ He replied, ‘Indeed, by Your might, my Lord, but I cannot do without Your blessing.’”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7494, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا كَلاَمَ اللَّهِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَغَرِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يَتَنَزَّلُ رَبُّنَا تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا حِينَ يَبْقَى ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ الآخِرُ فَيَقُولُ مَنْ يَدْعُونِي فَأَسْتَجِيبَ لَهُ، مَنْ يَسْأَلُنِي فَأُعْطِيَهُ، مَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرُنِي فَأَغْفِرَ لَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Ismail narrated to us: Malik narrated to me, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Abdullah al-Agharr, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah said, “Our Lord, Blessed and Exalted, descends every night to the lowest heaven when the final third of the night remains and says, ‘Who is calling upon Me, that I may answer him? Who is asking Me, that I may give him? Who is seeking My forgiveness, that I may forgive him?’”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7495, 7496, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا كَلاَمَ اللَّهِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، أَنَّ الأَعْرَجَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ نَحْنُ الآخِرُونَ السَّابِقُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَبِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏"‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ أَنْفِقْ أُنْفِقْ عَلَيْكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Abu al-Yaman informed us: Shu‘ayb informed us: Abu al-Zinad narrated to us, that al-A‘raj narrated to him, that he heard Abu Hurayrah say that he heard the Messenger of Allah say, “We are the last, yet we will be the foremost on the Day of Resurrection.” With this same chain: “Allah says, ‘Spend, and I will spend on you.’”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7497, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا كَلاَمَ اللَّهِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَذِهِ خَدِيجَةُ أَتَتْكَ بِإِنَاءٍ فِيهِ طَعَامٌ أَوْ إِنَاءٍ فِيهِ شَرَابٌ فَأَقْرِئْهَا مِنْ رَبِّهَا السَّلاَمَ وَبَشِّرْهَا بِبَيْتٍ مِنْ قَصَبٍ لاَ صَخَبَ فِيهِ وَلاَ نَصَبَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us: Ibn Fudayl narrated to us, from Umārah, from Abu Zur‘ah, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: Gabriel said, “This is Khadijah. She has come to you with a vessel containing food or drink. Convey to her greetings of peace from her Lord and give her the glad tidings of a house of reeds in which there will be neither clamour nor weariness.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7498, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا كَلاَمَ اللَّهِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ أَسَدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ أَعْدَدْتُ لِعِبَادِي الصَّالِحِينَ مَا لاَ عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ، وَلاَ أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ، وَلاَ خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Muadh ibn Asad informed us: Abdullah informed us: Ma‘mar informed us, from Hammam ibn Munabbih, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet, who said: “Allah said, ‘I have prepared for My righteous servants what no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and what has never occurred to a human heart.’”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7499, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا كَلاَمَ اللَّهِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ الأَحْوَلُ، أَنَّ طَاوُسًا، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا تَهَجَّدَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ أَنْتَ الْحَقُّ، وَوَعْدُكَ الْحَقُّ وَقَوْلُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَلِقَاؤُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَالْجَنَّةُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّارُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّبِيُّونَ حَقٌّ، وَالسَّاعَةُ حَقٌّ، اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ، وَبِكَ خَاصَمْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ حَاكَمْتُ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، أَنْتَ إِلَهِي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Mahmud narrated to us: Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us: Ibn Jurayj informed us: Sulayman al-Ahwal informed me that Tawus informed him that he heard Ibn Abbas say: When the Prophet prayed at night, he would say, “O Allah, praise belongs to You. You are the Light of the heavens and earth, You sustain the heavens and earth, and You are the Lord of the heavens and earth and all in them. You are the Truth; Your promise, word, and meeting You are true; Paradise, the Fire, the Prophets, and the Hour are true. O Allah, to You I submit, in You I believe, upon You I rely, to You I turn, by You I contend, and to You I refer judgment. Forgive what I sent ahead and left behind, what I concealed and declared. You are my God; there is no god but You.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7500, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا كَلاَمَ اللَّهِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ النُّمَيْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الأَيْلِيُّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، وَسَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَعَلْقَمَةَ بْنَ وَقَّاصٍ، وَعُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ حَدِيثِ، عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ قَالَ لَهَا أَهْلُ الإِفْكِ مَا قَالُوا فَبَرَّأَهَا اللَّهُ مِمَّا قَالُوا ـ وَكُلٌّ حَدَّثَنِي طَائِفَةً مِنَ الْحَدِيثِ الَّذِي حَدَّثَنِي ـ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ وَلَكِنْ وَاللَّهِ مَا كُنْتُ أَظُنُّ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُنْزِلُ فِي بَرَاءَتِي وَحْيًا يُتْلَى، وَلَشَأْنِي فِي نَفْسِي كَانَ أَحْقَرَ مِنْ أَنْ يَتَكَلَّمَ اللَّهُ فِيَّ بِأَمْرٍ يُتْلَى، وَلَكِنِّي كُنْتُ أَرْجُو أَنْ يَرَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي النَّوْمِ رُؤْيَا يُبَرِّئُنِي اللَّهُ بِهَا فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏[quran sura="24" aya_start="11" aya_end="11"]{‏إِنَّ الَّذِينَ جَاءُوا بِالإِفْكِ‏}‏ الْعَشْرَ الآيَاتِ‏.‏
en_text: Hajjaj ibn Minhal narrated to us: Abdullah ibn Umar al-Numayri narrated to us: Yunus ibn Yazid al-Ayli narrated to us: I heard al-Zuhri say: I heard Urwah ibn al-Zubayr, Sa‘id ibn al-Musayyab, Alqamah ibn Waqqas, and Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah narrate about the report of Aishah, the wife of the Prophet, concerning what the people of the slander said about her and how Allah declared her innocent of it. Each of them narrated to me part of what he had heard from Aishah. She said: By Allah, I never thought that Allah would send down recited revelation declaring me innocent. I considered my situation too insignificant for Allah to speak about me in a matter that would be recited. I only hoped that the Messenger of Allah might see a dream in which Allah would declare me innocent. Then Allah Most High revealed, “Indeed, those who brought the slander…” the ten verses Quran 24:11.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7501, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا كَلاَمَ اللَّهِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ إِذَا أَرَادَ عَبْدِي أَنْ يَعْمَلَ سَيِّئَةً فَلاَ تَكْتُبُوهَا عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى يَعْمَلَهَا، فَإِنْ عَمِلَهَا فَاكْتُبُوهَا بِمِثْلِهَا وَإِنْ تَرَكَهَا مِنْ أَجْلِي فَاكْتُبُوهَا لَهُ حَسَنَةً وَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَعْمَلَ حَسَنَةً فَلَمْ يَعْمَلْهَا فَاكْتُبُوهَا لَهُ حَسَنَةً، فَإِنْ عَمِلَهَا فَاكْتُبُوهَا لَهُ بِعَشْرِ أَمْثَالِهَا إِلَى سَبْعِمِائَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa‘id narrated to us: al-Mughirah ibn Abd al-Rahman narrated to us, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A‘raj, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah said: “Allah says, ‘When My servant intends to do a bad deed, do not record it against him until he does it. If he does it, record it as one like it. If he leaves it for My sake, record it for him as a good deed. When he intends to do a good deed but does not do it, record it for him as a good deed. If he does it, record it for him as ten times its like, up to seven hundred times.’”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7502, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا كَلاَمَ اللَّهِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مُزَرِّدٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ مِنْهُ قَامَتِ الرَّحِمُ فَقَالَ مَهْ‏.‏ قَالَتْ هَذَا مَقَامُ الْعَائِذِ بِكَ مِنَ الْقَطِيعَةِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَلاَ تَرْضَيْنَ أَنْ أَصِلَ مَنْ وَصَلَكِ، وَأَقْطَعَ مَنْ قَطَعَكِ قَالَتْ بَلَى يَا رَبِّ‏.‏ قَالَ فَذَلِكِ لَكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ ‏[quran sura="47" aya_start="22" aya_end="22"]{‏فَهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ أَنْ تُفْسِدُوا فِي الأَرْضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوا أَرْحَامَكُمْ‏}‏
en_text: Ismail ibn Abdullah narrated to us: Sulayman ibn Bilal narrated to me, from Muawiyah ibn Abi Muzarrid, from Sa‘id ibn Yasar, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah said: “Allah created creation, and when He had finished, the womb stood and said, ‘This is the standing of one seeking refuge in You from severing ties.’ He said, ‘Will you not be pleased that I maintain ties with whoever maintains you and sever ties with whoever severs you?’ It said, ‘Yes, my Lord.’ He said, ‘That is for you.’” Then Abu Hurayrah recited: “Would you then, if you were given authority, spread corruption in the land and sever your ties of kinship?” Quran 47:22.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7503, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا كَلاَمَ اللَّهِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، قَالَ مُطِرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ أَصْبَحَ مِنْ عِبَادِي كَافِرٌ بِي وَمُؤْمِنٌ بِي ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Musaddad narrated to us: Sufyan narrated to us, from Salih, from Ubaydullah, from Zayd ibn Khalid, who said: Rain fell upon the Prophet, and he said, “Some of My servants have entered the morning as disbelievers in Me and believers in Me.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7504, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا كَلاَمَ اللَّهِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ إِذَا أَحَبَّ عَبْدِي لِقَائِي أَحْبَبْتُ لِقَاءَهُ، وَإِذَا كَرِهَ لِقَائِي كَرِهْتُ لِقَاءَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Ismail narrated to us: Malik narrated to me, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A‘raj, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah said: “Allah says, ‘When My servant loves to meet Me, I love to meet him; and when he dislikes meeting Me, I dislike meeting him.’”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7505, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا كَلاَمَ اللَّهِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ أَنَا عِنْدَ ظَنِّ عَبْدِي بِي ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Abu al-Yaman informed us: Shu‘ayb informed us: Abu al-Zinad narrated to us, from al-A‘raj, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah said: “Allah says, ‘I am as My servant thinks of Me.’”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7506, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا كَلاَمَ اللَّهِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ قَالَ رَجُلٌ لَمْ يَعْمَلْ خَيْرًا قَطُّ، فَإِذَا مَاتَ فَحَرِّقُوهُ وَاذْرُوا نِصْفَهُ فِي الْبَرِّ وَنِصْفَهُ فِي الْبَحْرِ فَوَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ قَدَرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ لَيُعَذِّبَنَّهُ عَذَابًا لاَ يُعَذِّبُهُ أَحَدًا مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ، فَأَمَرَ اللَّهُ الْبَحْرَ فَجَمَعَ مَا فِيهِ، وَأَمَرَ الْبَرَّ فَجَمَعَ مَا فِيهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِمَ فَعَلْتَ قَالَ مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ، وَأَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ، فَغَفَرَ لَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Ismail narrated to us: Malik narrated to me, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A‘raj, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah said: “A man who had never done any good said, ‘When I die, burn me and scatter half of me on land and half in the sea. By Allah, if Allah gains power over me, He will punish me with a punishment with which He has punished no one among the worlds.’ Allah commanded the sea to gather what was in it and the land to gather what was in it. Then He said to him, ‘Why did you do that?’ He replied, ‘Out of fear of You, though You know best.’ So He forgave him.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7507, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا كَلاَمَ اللَّهِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ عَبْدًا أَصَابَ ذَنْبًا ـ وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ أَذْنَبَ ذَنْبًا ـ فَقَالَ رَبِّ أَذْنَبْتُ ـ وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ أَصَبْتُ ـ فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَقَالَ رَبُّهُ أَعَلِمَ عَبْدِي أَنَّ لَهُ رَبًّا يَغْفِرُ الذَّنْبَ وَيَأْخُذُ بِهِ غَفَرْتُ لِعَبْدِي‏.‏ ثُمَّ مَكَثَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ، ثُمَّ أَصَابَ ذَنْبًا أَوْ أَذْنَبَ ذَنْبًا، فَقَالَ رَبِّ أَذْنَبْتُ ـ أَوْ أَصَبْتُ ـ آخَرَ فَاغْفِرْهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَعَلِمَ عَبْدِي أَنَّ لَهُ رَبًّا يَغْفِرُ الذَّنْبَ وَيَأْخُذُ بِهِ غَفَرْتُ لِعَبْدِي، ثُمَّ مَكَثَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ أَذْنَبَ ذَنْبًا ـ وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ أَصَابَ ذَنْبًا ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَبِّ أَصَبْتُ ـ أَوْ أَذْنَبْتُ ـ آخَرَ فَاغْفِرْهُ لِي‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَعَلِمَ عَبْدِي أَنَّ لَهُ رَبًّا يَغْفِرُ الذَّنْبَ وَيَأْخُذُ بِهِ غَفَرْتُ لِعَبْدِي ـ ثَلاَثًا ـ فَلْيَعْمَلْ مَا شَاءَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Ahmad ibn Ishaq narrated to us: Amr ibn Asim narrated to us: Hammam narrated to us: Ishaq ibn Abdullah narrated to us: I heard Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Amrah say: I heard Abu Hurayrah say: I heard the Prophet say: “A servant committed a sin”—or he said, “did something sinful”—“and said, ‘My Lord, I have sinned’”—or, “I did wrong”—“so forgive me. His Lord said, ‘Does My servant know that he has a Lord who forgives sins and punishes for them? I have forgiven My servant.’ Then he remained for as long as Allah willed and committed another sin—or did wrong—and said, ‘My Lord, I have sinned again, so forgive me.’ He said, ‘Does My servant know that he has a Lord who forgives sins and punishes for them? I have forgiven My servant.’ Then he remained for as long as Allah willed and sinned again—or did wrong—and said, ‘My Lord, I have sinned again, so forgive me.’ He said, ‘Does My servant know that he has a Lord who forgives sins and punishes for them? I have forgiven My servant’”—three times—“so let him do as he wishes.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7508, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا كَلاَمَ اللَّهِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْغَافِرِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَنَّهُ ذَكَرَ رَجُلاً فِيمَنْ سَلَفَ ـ أَوْ فِيمَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ قَالَ كَلِمَةً يَعْنِي ـ أَعْطَاهُ اللَّهُ مَالاً وَوَلَدًا ـ فَلَمَّا حَضَرَتِ الْوَفَاةُ قَالَ لِبَنِيهِ أَىَّ أَبٍ كُنْتُ لَكُمْ قَالُوا خَيْرَ أَبٍ‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَبْتَئِرْ ـ أَوْ لَمْ يَبْتَئِزْ ـ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرًا، وَإِنْ يَقْدِرِ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ يُعَذِّبْهُ، فَانْظُرُوا إِذَا مُتُّ فَأَحْرِقُونِي حَتَّى إِذَا صِرْتُ فَحْمًا فَاسْحَقُونِي ـ أَوْ قَالَ فَاسْحَكُونِي ـ فَإِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ رِيحٍ عَاصِفٍ فَأَذْرُونِي فِيهَا ‏"‏ فَقَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَأَخَذَ مَوَاثِيقَهُمْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ وَرَبِّي، فَفَعَلُوا ثُمَّ أَذْرَوْهُ فِي يَوْمٍ عَاصِفٍ، فَقَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ كُنْ‏.‏ فَإِذَا هُوَ رَجُلٌ قَائِمٌ‏.‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ أَىْ عَبْدِي مَا حَمَلَكَ عَلَى أَنْ فَعَلْتَ مَا فَعَلْتَ قَالَ مَخَافَتُكَ أَوْ فَرَقٌ مِنْكَ قَالَ فَمَا تَلاَفَاهُ أَنْ رَحِمَهُ عِنْدَهَا ـ وَقَالَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى فَمَا تَلاَفَاهُ غَيْرُهَا ـ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهِ أَبَا عُثْمَانَ فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ هَذَا مِنْ سَلْمَانَ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ زَادَ فِيهِ أَذْرُونِي فِي الْبَحْرِ‏.‏ أَوْ كَمَا حَدَّثَ‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، وَقَالَ، لَمْ يَبْتَئِرْ‏.‏ وَقَالَ خَلِيفَةُ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، وَقَالَ، لَمْ يَبْتَئِزْ‏.‏ فَسَّرَهُ قَتَادَةُ لَمْ يَدَّخِرْ‏.‏
en_text: Abdullah ibn Abi al-Aswad narrated to us: Mu‘tamir narrated to us: I heard my father say: Qatadah narrated to us, from Uqbah ibn Abd al-Ghafir, from Abu Sa‘id, from the Prophet, who mentioned a man among those who came before you. He said that Allah had given the man wealth and children. When death approached, he said to his sons, “What kind of father have I been to you?” They said, “A good father.” He said, “But he has stored up no good with Allah, and if Allah gains power over him, He will punish him. So when I die, burn me until I become charcoal, then crush me”—or he said, “grind me”—“and when there is a stormy windy day, scatter me in it.” The Prophet of Allah said, “He made them swear by my Lord to do that. They did so and scattered him on a stormy day. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said, ‘Be,’ and there he was, a man standing. Allah said, ‘My servant, what made you do what you did?’ He replied, ‘Fear of You,’ or, ‘dread of You.’ Nothing but His mercy then overtook him”—or on another occasion he said, “Nothing but that overtook him.” I related this to Abu Uthman, who said, “I heard this from Salman, except that he added: ‘Scatter me in the sea,’ or words to that effect.” Musa narrated to us: Mu‘tamir narrated to us and said “lam yabta’ir.” Khalifah narrated to us: Mu‘tamir narrated to us and said “lam yabta’iz.” Qatadah explained it as “he did not save up.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7509, book 97, باب كَلاَمِ الرَّبِّ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَعَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ وَغَيْرِهِمْ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ رَاشِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ شُفِّعْتُ، فَقُلْتُ يَا رَبِّ أَدْخِلِ الْجَنَّةَ مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ خَرْدَلَةٌ‏.‏ فَيَدْخُلُونَ، ثُمَّ أَقُولُ أَدْخِلِ الْجَنَّةَ مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ أَدْنَى شَىْءٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَنَسٌ كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى أَصَابِعِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
en_text: Yusuf ibn Rashid narrated to us: Ahmad ibn Abdullah narrated to us: Abu Bakr ibn Ayyash narrated to us, from Humayd, who said: I heard Anas say: I heard the Prophet say: “On the Day of Resurrection I will be granted intercession. I will say, ‘My Lord, admit to Paradise whoever has a mustard seed’s weight in his heart.’ They will enter. Then I will say, ‘Admit to Paradise whoever has even the least thing in his heart.’” Anas said: It is as though I can see the fingers of the Messenger of Allah.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7510, book 97, باب كَلاَمِ الرَّبِّ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَعَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ وَغَيْرِهِمْ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْبَدُ بْنُ هِلاَلٍ الْعَنَزِيُّ، قَالَ اجْتَمَعْنَا نَاسٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْبَصْرَةِ فَذَهَبْنَا إِلَى أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ وَذَهَبْنَا مَعَنَا بِثَابِتٍ إِلَيْهِ يَسْأَلُهُ لَنَا عَنْ حَدِيثِ الشَّفَاعَةِ، فَإِذَا هُوَ فِي قَصْرِهِ فَوَافَقْنَاهُ يُصَلِّي الضُّحَى، فَاسْتَأْذَنَّا، فَأَذِنَ لَنَا وَهْوَ قَاعِدٌ عَلَى فِرَاشِهِ فَقُلْنَا لِثَابِتٍ لاَ تَسْأَلْهُ عَنْ شَىْءٍ أَوَّلَ مِنْ حَدِيثِ الشَّفَاعَةِ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا حَمْزَةَ هَؤُلاَءِ إِخْوَانُكَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْبَصْرَةِ جَاءُوكَ يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنْ حَدِيثِ الشَّفَاعَةِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ مَاجَ النَّاسُ بَعْضُهُمْ فِي بَعْضٍ فَيَأْتُونَ آدَمَ فَيَقُولُونَ اشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّكَ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ لَسْتُ لَهَا وَلَكِنْ عَلَيْكُمْ بِإِبْرَاهِيمَ فَإِنَّهُ خَلِيلُ الرَّحْمَنِ‏.‏ فَيَأْتُونَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فَيَقُولُ لَسْتُ لَهَا وَلَكِنْ عَلَيْكُمْ بِمُوسَى فَإِنَّهُ كَلِيمُ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَيَأْتُونَ مُوسَى فَيَقُولُ لَسْتُ لَهَا وَلَكِنْ عَلَيْكُمْ بِعِيسَى فَإِنَّهُ رُوحُ اللَّهِ وَكَلِمَتُهُ‏.‏ فَيَأْتُونَ عِيسَى فَيَقُولُ لَسْتُ لَهَا وَلَكِنْ عَلَيْكُمْ بِمُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيَأْتُونِي فَأَقُولُ أَنَا لَهَا‏.‏ فَأَسْتَأْذِنُ عَلَى رَبِّي فَيُؤْذَنُ لِي وَيُلْهِمُنِي مَحَامِدَ أَحْمَدُهُ بِهَا لاَ تَحْضُرُنِي الآنَ، فَأَحْمَدُهُ بِتِلْكَ الْمَحَامِدِ وَأَخِرُّ لَهُ سَاجِدًا فَيُقَالُ يَا مُحَمَّدُ ارْفَعْ رَأْسَكَ، وَقُلْ يُسْمَعْ لَكَ، وَسَلْ تُعْطَ، وَاشْفَعْ تُشَفَّعْ‏.‏ فَأَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ أُمَّتِي أُمَّتِي‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ انْطَلِقْ فَأَخْرِجْ مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ شَعِيرَةٍ مِنْ إِيمَانٍ‏.‏ فَأَنْطَلِقُ فَأَفْعَلُ ثُمَّ أَعُودُ فَأَحْمَدُهُ بِتِلْكَ الْمَحَامِدِ، ثُمَّ أَخِرُّ لَهُ سَاجِدًا فَيُقَالُ يَا مُحَمَّدُ ارْفَعْ رَأْسَكَ، وَقُلْ يُسْمَعْ لَكَ، وَسَلْ تُعْطَ، وَاشْفَعْ تُشَفَّعْ، فَأَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ أُمَّتِي أُمَّتِي‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ انْطَلِقْ فَأَخْرِجْ مِنْهَا مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ أَوْ خَرْدَلَةٍ مِنْ إِيمَانٍ‏.‏ فَأَنْطَلِقُ فَأَفْعَلُ ثُمَّ أَعُودُ فَأَحْمَدُهُ بِتِلْكَ الْمَحَامِدِ، ثُمَّ أَخِرُّ لَهُ سَاجِدًا فَيُقَالُ يَا مُحَمَّدُ ارْفَعْ رَأْسَكَ، وَقُلْ يُسْمَعْ لَكَ، وَسَلْ تُعْطَ، وَاشْفَعْ تُشَفَّعْ‏.‏ فَأَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ أُمَّتِي أُمَّتِي‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ انْطَلِقْ فَأَخْرِجْ مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ أَدْنَى أَدْنَى أَدْنَى مِثْقَالِ حَبَّةِ خَرْدَلٍ مِنْ إِيمَانٍ، فَأَخْرِجْهُ مِنَ النَّارِ‏.‏ فَأَنْطَلِقُ فَأَفْعَلُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا خَرَجْنَا مِنْ عِنْدِ أَنَسٍ قُلْتُ لِبَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا لَوْ مَرَرْنَا بِالْحَسَنِ وَهْوَ مُتَوَارٍ فِي مَنْزِلِ أَبِي خَلِيفَةَ فَحَدَّثَنَا بِمَا حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، فَأَتَيْنَاهُ فَسَلَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ فَأَذِنَ لَنَا فَقُلْنَا لَهُ يَا أَبَا سَعِيدٍ جِئْنَاكَ مِنْ عِنْدِ أَخِيكَ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ فَلَمْ نَرَ مِثْلَ مَا حَدَّثَنَا فِي الشَّفَاعَةِ، فَقَالَ هِيهِ، فَحَدَّثْنَاهُ بِالْحَدِيثِ فَانْتَهَى إِلَى هَذَا الْمَوْضِعِ فَقَالَ هِيهِ، فَقُلْنَا لَمْ يَزِدْ لَنَا عَلَى هَذَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَقَدْ حَدَّثَنِي وَهْوَ جَمِيعٌ مُنْذُ عِشْرِينَ سَنَةً فَلاَ أَدْرِي أَنَسِيَ أَمْ كَرِهَ أَنْ تَتَّكِلُوا‏.‏ قُلْنَا يَا أَبَا سَعِيدٍ فَحَدِّثْنَا، فَضَحِكَ وَقَالَ خُلِقَ الإِنْسَانُ عَجُولاً مَا ذَكَرْتُهُ إِلاَّ وَأَنَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُحَدِّثَكُمْ حَدَّثَنِي كَمَا حَدَّثَكُمْ بِهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ أَعُودُ الرَّابِعَةَ فَأَحْمَدُهُ بِتِلْكَ، ثُمَّ أَخِرُّ لَهُ سَاجِدًا فَيُقَالُ يَا مُحَمَّدُ ارْفَعْ رَأْسَكَ وَقُلْ يُسْمَعْ، وَسَلْ تُعْطَهْ، وَاشْفَعْ تُشَفَّعْ‏.‏ فَأَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ ائْذَنْ لِي فِيمَنْ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ وَعِزَّتِي وَجَلاَلِي وَكِبْرِيَائِي وَعَظَمَتِي لأُخْرِجَنَّ مِنْهَا مَنْ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Sulayman ibn Harb narrated to us: Hammad ibn Zayd narrated to us: Ma‘bad ibn Hilal al-Anazi said: A group of people from Basra gathered, and we went to Anas ibn Malik, taking Thabit with us so that he would ask Anas about the hadith of intercession for us. We found him in his palace, having finished the forenoon prayer. We asked permission, and he admitted us while seated on his bed. We said to Thabit, “Do not ask him anything before asking about the hadith of intercession.” He said, “Abu Hamzah, these are your brothers from Basra. They have come to ask you about the hadith of intercession.” Anas said: Muhammad narrated to us: “When the Day of Resurrection comes, people will surge against one another. They will come to Adam and say, ‘Intercede for us with your Lord.’ He will say, ‘I am not suited for that, but go to Ibrahim, for he is the close friend of the Most Merciful.’ They will go to Ibrahim, who will say, ‘I am not suited for that, but go to Moses, for Allah spoke to him.’ They will go to Moses, who will say, ‘I am not suited for that, but go to Jesus, for he is the Spirit of Allah and His Word.’ They will go to Jesus, who will say, ‘I am not suited for that, but go to Muhammad.’ They will come to me, and I will say, ‘I am suited for that.’ I will ask my Lord’s permission, and it will be granted to me. He will inspire me with praises by which to praise Him, which do not occur to me now. I will praise Him with those praises and fall down prostrate before Him. It will be said, ‘O Muhammad, raise your head. Speak, and you will be heard; ask, and you will be given; intercede, and your intercession will be accepted.’ I will say, ‘My Lord, my community, my community.’ It will be said, ‘Go and bring out whoever has in his heart faith weighing a barley grain.’ I will go and do so, then return and praise Him with those praises and fall down prostrate before Him. It will be said, ‘O Muhammad, raise your head. Speak, and you will be heard; ask, and you will be given; intercede, and your intercession will be accepted.’ I will say, ‘My Lord, my community, my community.’ It will be said, ‘Go and bring out whoever has in his heart faith weighing a speck or a mustard seed.’ I will go and do so, then return and praise Him with those praises and fall down prostrate before Him. It will be said, ‘O Muhammad, raise your head. Speak, and you will be heard; ask, and you will be given; intercede, and your intercession will be accepted.’ I will say, ‘My Lord, my community, my community.’ He will say, ‘Go and bring out whoever has the very least, the very least, the very least faith in his heart, the weight of a mustard seed, and bring him out of the Fire.’ I will go and do so.” When we left Anas, I said to some of our companions, “If only we went to al-Hasan, who is staying in Abu Khalifah’s house, and he told us what Anas ibn Malik told us.” We went to him, greeted him, and he admitted us. We said, “Abu Sa‘id, we have come from your brother Anas ibn Malik, and we have not heard the same account of intercession that you narrated.” He said, “Tell me.” We recounted the hadith to him. When we reached this point, he said, “Tell me more.” We said, “He did not add anything beyond this.” He said, “He narrated it to me in full twenty years ago. I do not know whether he forgot or disliked that you should rely on it.” We said, “Abu Sa‘id, then narrate it to us.” He laughed and said, “Man was created hasty. I never mention it except that I intend to narrate it to you.” He narrated it to us just as Anas had, then said: “Then I will return a fourth time and praise Him with those praises, then fall down prostrate before Him. It will be said, ‘O Muhammad, raise your head. Speak, and you will be heard; ask, and you will be given; intercede, and your intercession will be accepted.’ I will say, ‘My Lord, give me permission concerning whoever said, “There is no god but Allah.”’ He will say, ‘By My might, majesty, grandeur, and greatness, I will surely bring out of it whoever said, “There is no god but Allah.”’”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7511, book 97, باب كَلاَمِ الرَّبِّ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَعَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ وَغَيْرِهِمْ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ آخِرَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ دُخُولاً الْجَنَّةَ، وَآخِرَ أَهْلِ النَّارِ خُرُوجًا مِنَ النَّارِ رَجُلٌ يَخْرُجُ حَبْوًا فَيَقُولُ لَهُ رَبُّهُ ادْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّ الْجَنَّةُ مَلأَى‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ لَهُ ذَلِكَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ فَكُلُّ ذَلِكَ يُعِيدُ عَلَيْهِ الْجَنَّةُ مَلأَى‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ إِنَّ لَكَ مِثْلَ الدُّنْيَا عَشْرَ مِرَارٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Khalid narrated to us: Ubaydullah ibn Musa narrated to us, from Isra’il, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from Abidah, from Abdullah, who said: The Messenger of Allah said, “The last of the people of Paradise to enter Paradise and the last of the people of the Fire to come out of the Fire will be a man who crawls out. His Lord will say to him, ‘Enter Paradise.’ He will say, ‘My Lord, it is full.’ He will say that to him three times, and each time he will repeat, ‘It is full.’ Then He will say, ‘You will have the like of the world ten times over.’”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7512, book 97, باب كَلاَمِ الرَّبِّ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَعَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ وَغَيْرِهِمْ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ سَيُكَلِّمُهُ رَبُّهُ، لَيْسَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهُ تَرْجُمَانٌ، فَيَنْظُرُ أَيْمَنَ مِنْهُ فَلاَ يَرَى إِلاَّ مَا قَدَّمَ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ، وَيَنْظُرُ أَشْأَمَ مِنْهُ فَلاَ يَرَى إِلاَّ مَا قَدَّمَ، وَيَنْظُرُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فَلاَ يَرَى إِلاَّ النَّارَ تِلْقَاءَ وَجْهِهِ، فَاتَّقُوا النَّارَ وَلَوْ بِشِقِّ تَمْرَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ الأَعْمَشُ وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ مُرَّةَ عَنْ خَيْثَمَةَ مِثْلَهُ وَزَادَ فِيهِ ‏"‏ وَلَوْ بِكَلِمَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Ali ibn Hujr informed us: Isa ibn Yunus informed us, from al-A‘mash, from Khaythamah, from Adi ibn Hatim, who said: The Messenger of Allah said, “There is none of you except that his Lord will speak to him, with no interpreter between them. He will look to his right and see only what he sent ahead of deeds; he will look to his left and see only what he sent ahead; and he will look in front of him and see only the Fire facing him. So protect yourselves from the Fire, even with half a date.” Al-A‘mash said: Amr ibn Murrah narrated to me, from Khaythamah, a similar report, adding, “even with a good word.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7513, book 97, باب كَلاَمِ الرَّبِّ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَعَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ وَغَيْرِهِمْ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ جَاءَ حَبْرٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ، وَالأَرَضِينَ عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ، وَالْمَاءَ وَالثَّرَى عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ، وَالْخَلاَئِقَ عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ، ثُمَّ يَهُزُّهُنَّ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَنَا الْمَلِكُ أَنَا الْمَلِكُ‏.‏ فَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَضْحَكُ حَتَّى بَدَتْ نَوَاجِذُهُ تَعَجُّبًا وَتَصْدِيقًا، لِقَوْلِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏[quran sura="6" aya_start="91" aya_end="91"]{‏وَمَا قَدَرُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏يُشْرِكُونَ‏}‏
en_text: Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: Jarir narrated to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from Abidah, from Abdullah, who said: A Jewish scholar came and said, “On the Day of Resurrection, Allah will place the heavens on one finger, the earths on one finger, the water and soil on one finger, and all creatures on one finger. Then He will shake them and say, ‘I am the King, I am the King.’” I saw the Prophet laugh until his molars appeared, in amazement and affirmation of what he said. Then the Prophet recited, “They have not appraised Allah with the appraisal due to Him…” through “they associate with Him” Quran 6:91.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7514, book 97, باب كَلاَمِ الرَّبِّ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَعَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ وَغَيْرِهِمْ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ مُحْرِزٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ كَيْفَ سَمِعْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ فِي النَّجْوَى قَالَ ‏"‏ يَدْنُو أَحَدُكُمْ مِنْ رَبِّهِ حَتَّى يَضَعَ كَنَفَهُ عَلَيْهِ فَيَقُولُ أَعَمِلْتَ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَيَقُولُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ وَيَقُولُ عَمِلْتَ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَيَقُولُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَيُقَرِّرُهُ، ثُمَّ يَقُولُ إِنِّي سَتَرْتُ عَلَيْكَ فِي الدُّنْيَا، وَأَنَا أَغْفِرُهَا لَكَ الْيَوْمَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ آدَمُ حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم.
en_text: Musaddad narrated to us: Abu Awanah narrated to us, from Qatadah, from Safwan ibn Muhriz, that a man asked Ibn Umar, “How did you hear the Messenger of Allah speak about private conversation?” He said: “One of you will draw near to his Lord until He covers him, then say, ‘Did you do such-and-such?’ He will say, ‘Yes.’ He will say, ‘Did you do such-and-such?’ He will say, ‘Yes.’ He will make him acknowledge it, then say, ‘I concealed it for you in the world, and today I forgive it for you.’” Adam said: Shayban narrated to us: Qatadah narrated to us: Safwan narrated to us, from Ibn Umar, who said: I heard the Prophet.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7515, book 97, باب قَوْلِهِ ‏ {‏وَكَلَّمَ اللَّهُ مُوسَى تَكْلِيمًا‏} ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، حَدَّثَنَا عُقَيْلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ احْتَجَّ آدَمُ وَمُوسَى، فَقَالَ مُوسَى أَنْتَ آدَمُ الَّذِي أَخْرَجْتَ ذُرِّيَّتَكَ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ‏.‏ قَالَ آدَمُ أَنْتَ مُوسَى الَّذِي اصْطَفَاكَ اللَّهُ بِرِسَالاَتِهِ وَكَلاَمِهِ، ثُمَّ تَلُومُنِي عَلَى أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِّرَ عَلَىَّ قَبْلَ أَنْ أُخْلَقَ‏.‏ فَحَجَّ آدَمُ مُوسَى ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Bukayr narrated to us: al-Layth narrated to us: Uqayl narrated to us, from Ibn Shihab: Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman narrated to us, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Prophet said: “Adam and Moses argued. Moses said, ‘You are Adam, who brought your descendants out of Paradise.’ Adam said, ‘You are Moses, whom Allah chose with His messages and speech, yet you blame me for something decreed for me before I was created.’ Thus Adam prevailed over Moses in the argument.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7516, book 97, باب قَوْلِهِ ‏ {‏وَكَلَّمَ اللَّهُ مُوسَى تَكْلِيمًا‏} ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يُجْمَعُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَيَقُولُونَ لَوِ اسْتَشْفَعْنَا إِلَى رَبِّنَا، فَيُرِيحُنَا مِنْ مَكَانِنَا هَذَا‏.‏ فَيَأْتُونَ آدَمَ فَيَقُولُونَ لَهُ أَنْتَ آدَمُ أَبُو الْبَشَرِ خَلَقَكَ اللَّهُ بِيَدِهِ وَأَسْجَدَ لَكَ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ وَعَلَّمَكَ أَسْمَاءَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ، فَاشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّنَا حَتَّى يُرِيحَنَا‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ لَهُمْ لَسْتُ هُنَاكُمْ‏.‏ فَيَذْكُرُ لَهُمْ خَطِيئَتَهُ الَّتِي أَصَابَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Muslim ibn Ibrahim narrated to us: Hisham narrated to us: Qatadah narrated to us, from Anas, who said: The Messenger of Allah said, “The believers will be gathered on the Day of Resurrection and will say, ‘If only we sought intercession with our Lord, so He might relieve us from this place.’ They will go to Adam and say, ‘You are Adam, the father of humanity. Allah created you with His hand, made the angels prostrate to you, and taught you the names of everything. Intercede for us with your Lord so that He may relieve us.’ He will say to them, ‘I am not suited for that,’ and he will mention to them the mistake he committed.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7517, book 97, باب قَوْلِهِ ‏ {‏وَكَلَّمَ اللَّهُ مُوسَى تَكْلِيمًا‏} ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ شَرِيكِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ لَيْلَةَ أُسْرِيَ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ مَسْجِدِ الْكَعْبَةِ أَنَّهُ جَاءَهُ ثَلاَثَةُ نَفَرٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُوحَى إِلَيْهِ وَهْوَ نَائِمٌ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ، فَقَالَ أَوَّلُهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ هُوَ فَقَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ هُوَ خَيْرُهُمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ آخِرُهُمْ خُذُوا خَيْرَهُمْ‏.‏ فَكَانَتْ تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةَ، فَلَمْ يَرَهُمْ حَتَّى أَتَوْهُ لَيْلَةً أُخْرَى فِيمَا يَرَى قَلْبُهُ، وَتَنَامُ عَيْنُهُ وَلاَ يَنَامُ قَلْبُهُ وَكَذَلِكَ الأَنْبِيَاءُ تَنَامُ أَعْيُنُهُمْ وَلاَ تَنَامُ قُلُوبُهُمْ، فَلَمْ يُكَلِّمُوهُ حَتَّى احْتَمَلُوهُ فَوَضَعُوهُ عِنْدَ بِئْرِ زَمْزَمَ فَتَوَلاَّهُ مِنْهُمْ جِبْرِيلُ فَشَقَّ جِبْرِيلُ مَا بَيْنَ نَحْرِهِ إِلَى لَبَّتِهِ حَتَّى فَرَغَ مِنْ صَدْرِهِ وَجَوْفِهِ، فَغَسَلَهُ مِنْ مَاءِ زَمْزَمَ بِيَدِهِ، حَتَّى أَنْقَى جَوْفَهُ، ثُمَّ أُتِيَ بِطَسْتٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ فِيهِ تَوْرٌ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ مَحْشُوًّا إِيمَانًا وَحِكْمَةً، فَحَشَا بِهِ صَدْرَهُ وَلَغَادِيدَهُ ـ يَعْنِي عُرُوقَ حَلْقِهِ ـ ثُمَّ أَطْبَقَهُ ثُمَّ عَرَجَ بِهِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا فَضَرَبَ بَابًا مِنْ أَبْوَابِهَا فَنَادَاهُ أَهْلُ السَّمَاءِ مَنْ هَذَا فَقَالَ جِبْرِيلُ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَمَنْ مَعَكَ قَالَ مَعِي مُحَمَّدٌ‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَدْ بُعِثَ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالُوا فَمَرْحَبًا بِهِ وَأَهْلاً‏.‏ فَيَسْتَبْشِرُ بِهِ أَهْلُ السَّمَاءِ، لاَ يَعْلَمُ أَهْلُ السَّمَاءِ بِمَا يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ بِهِ فِي الأَرْضِ حَتَّى يُعْلِمَهُمْ، فَوَجَدَ فِي السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا آدَمَ فَقَالَ لَهُ جِبْرِيلُ هَذَا أَبُوكَفَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ وَرَدَّ عَلَيْهِ آدَمُ وَقَالَ مَرْحَبًا وَأَهْلاً بِابْنِي، نِعْمَ الاِبْنُ أَنْتَ‏.‏ فَإِذَا هُوَ فِي السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا بِنَهَرَيْنِ يَطَّرِدَانِ فَقَالَ مَا هَذَانِ النَّهَرَانِ يَا جِبْرِيلُ قَالَ هَذَا النِّيلُ وَالْفُرَاتُ عُنْصُرُهُمَا‏.‏ ثُمَّ مَضَى بِهِ فِي السَّمَاءِ فَإِذَا هُوَ بِنَهَرٍ آخَرَ عَلَيْهِ قَصْرٌ مِنْ لُؤْلُؤٍ وَزَبَرْجَدٍ فَضَرَبَ يَدَهُ فَإِذَا هُوَ مِسْكٌ قَالَ مَا هَذَا يَا جِبْرِيلُ قَالَ هَذَا الْكَوْثَرُ الَّذِي خَبَأَ لَكَ رَبُّكَ‏.‏ ثُمَّ عَرَجَ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الثَّانِيَةِ فَقَالَتِ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ لَهُ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَتْ لَهُ الأُولَى مَنْ هَذَا قَالَ جِبْرِيلُ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَمَنْ مَعَكَ قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ قَالُوا وَقَدْ بُعِثَ إِلَيْهِ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالُوا مَرْحَبًا بِهِ وَأَهْلاً‏.‏ ثُمَّ عَرَجَ بِهِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الثَّالِثَةِ وَقَالُوا لَهُ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَتِ الأُولَى وَالثَّانِيَةُ، ثُمَّ عَرَجَ بِهِ إِلَى الرَّابِعَةِ فَقَالُوا لَهُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ عَرَجَ بِهِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الْخَامِسَةِ فَقَالُوا مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ عَرَجَ بِهِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ السَّادِسَةِ فَقَالُوا لَهُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ عَرَجَ بِهِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ السَّابِعَةِ فَقَالُوا لَهُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، كُلُّ سَمَاءٍ فِيهَا أَنْبِيَاءُ قَدْ سَمَّاهُمْ فَأَوْعَيْتُ مِنْهُمْ إِدْرِيسَ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ، وَهَارُونَ فِي الرَّابِعَةِ، وَآخَرَ فِي الْخَامِسَةِ لَمْ أَحْفَظِ اسْمَهُ، وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي السَّادِسَةِ، وَمُوسَى فِي السَّابِعَةِ بِتَفْضِيلِ كَلاَمِ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ مُوسَى رَبِّ لَمْ أَظُنَّ أَنْ يُرْفَعَ عَلَىَّ أَحَدٌ‏.‏ ثُمَّ عَلاَ بِهِ فَوْقَ ذَلِكَ بِمَا لاَ يَعْلَمُهُ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، حَتَّى جَاءَ سِدْرَةَ الْمُنْتَهَى وَدَنَا الْجَبَّارُ رَبُّ الْعِزَّةِ فَتَدَلَّى حَتَّى كَانَ مِنْهُ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَى فَأَوْحَى اللَّهُ فِيمَا أَوْحَى إِلَيْهِ خَمْسِينَ صَلاَةً عَلَى أُمَّتِكَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ‏.‏ ثُمَّ هَبَطَ حَتَّى بَلَغَ مُوسَى فَاحْتَبَسَهُ مُوسَى فَقَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ مَاذَا عَهِدَ إِلَيْكَ رَبُّكَ قَالَ عَهِدَ إِلَىَّ خَمْسِينَ صَلاَةً كُلَّ يَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّ أُمَّتَكَ لاَ تَسْتَطِيعُ ذَلِكَ فَارْجِعْ فَلْيُخَفِّفْ عَنْكَ رَبُّكَ وَعَنْهُمْ‏.‏ فَالْتَفَتَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى جِبْرِيلَ كَأَنَّهُ يَسْتَشِيرُهُ فِي ذَلِكَ، فَأَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ جِبْرِيلُ أَنْ نَعَمْ إِنْ شِئْتَ‏.‏ فَعَلاَ بِهِ إِلَى الْجَبَّارِ فَقَالَ وَهْوَ مَكَانَهُ يَا رَبِّ خَفِّفْ عَنَّا، فَإِنَّ أُمَّتِي لاَ تَسْتَطِيعُ هَذَا‏.‏ فَوَضَعَ عَنْهُ عَشْرَ صَلَوَاتٍ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَى مُوسَى فَاحْتَبَسَهُ، فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يُرَدِّدُهُ مُوسَى إِلَى رَبِّهِ حَتَّى صَارَتْ إِلَى خَمْسِ صَلَوَاتٍ، ثُمَّ احْتَبَسَهُ مُوسَى عِنْدَ الْخَمْسِ فَقَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ رَاوَدْتُ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ قَوْمِي عَلَى أَدْنَى مِنْ هَذَا فَضَعُفُوا فَتَرَكُوهُ فَأُمَّتُكَ أَضْعَفُ أَجْسَادًا وَقُلُوبًا وَأَبْدَانًا وَأَبْصَارًا وَأَسْمَاعًا، فَارْجِعْ فَلْيُخَفِّفْ عَنْكَ رَبُّكَ، كُلَّ ذَلِكَ يَلْتَفِتُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى جِبْرِيلَ لِيُشِيرَ عَلَيْهِ وَلاَ يَكْرَهُ ذَلِكَ جِبْرِيلُ، فَرَفَعَهُ عِنْدَ الْخَامِسَةِ فَقَالَ يَا رَبِّ إِنَّ أُمَّتِي ضُعَفَاءُ أَجْسَادُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ وَأَسْمَاعُهُمْ وَأَبْدَانُهُمْ فَخَفِّفْ عَنَّا فَقَالَ الْجَبَّارُ يَا مُحَمَّدُ‏.‏ قَالَ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّهُ لاَ يُبَدَّلُ الْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ، كَمَا فَرَضْتُ عَلَيْكَ فِي أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ ـ قَالَ ـ فَكُلُّ حَسَنَةٍ بِعَشْرِ أَمْثَالِهَا، فَهْىَ خَمْسُونَ فِي أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ وَهْىَ خَمْسٌ عَلَيْكَ‏.‏ فَرَجَعَ إِلَى مُوسَى فَقَالَ كَيْفَ فَعَلْتَ فَقَالَ خَفَّفَ عَنَّا أَعْطَانَا بِكُلِّ حَسَنَةٍ عَشْرَ أَمْثَالِهَا‏.‏ قَالَ مُوسَى قَدْ وَاللَّهِ رَاوَدْتُ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ عَلَى أَدْنَى مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَتَرَكُوهُ، ارْجِعْ إِلَى رَبِّكَ فَلْيُخَفِّفْ عَنْكَ أَيْضًا‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَا مُوسَى قَدْ وَاللَّهِ اسْتَحْيَيْتُ مِنْ رَبِّي مِمَّا اخْتَلَفْتُ إِلَيْهِ‏.‏ قَالَ فَاهْبِطْ بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ وَاسْتَيْقَظَ وَهْوَ فِي مَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ‏.‏
en_text: Abd al-Aziz ibn Abdullah narrated to us: Sulayman narrated to me, from Sharik ibn Abdullah, who said: I heard Ibn Malik say: On the night the Messenger of Allah was taken on the Night Journey from the Mosque of the Ka‘bah, three men came to him before revelation had come to him, while he was asleep in the Sacred Mosque. The first said, “Which of them is he?” The middle one said, “He is the best of them.” The last said, “Take the best of them.” That was that night. He did not see them again until they came to him another night, as his heart perceived them; his eyes slept but his heart did not sleep. Such is the case with the Prophets: their eyes sleep, but their hearts do not sleep. They did not speak to him until they carried him and placed him beside the well of Zamzam. Gabriel took charge of him. Gabriel split open the area from the base of his neck to his chest until he had opened his chest and abdomen. He washed them with Zamzam water using his hand until he had cleansed his interior. Then a gold basin was brought, containing a gold vessel filled with faith and wisdom. He filled his chest and the veins of his throat with it—meaning the veins of his throat—then closed it up. He ascended with him to the lowest heaven and knocked at one of its gates. The inhabitants of heaven called to him, “Who is this?” He said, “Gabriel.” They said, “Who is with you?” He said, “Muhammad.” They said, “Has he been sent?” He said, “Yes.” They said, “Welcome to him.” The inhabitants of heaven rejoiced at him. The inhabitants of heaven do not know what Allah intends on earth until He informs them. In the lowest heaven he found Adam. Gabriel said to him, “This is your father; greet him.” He greeted him, and Adam returned the greeting and said, “Welcome, my son. What an excellent son you are.” In the lowest heaven there were two rivers flowing. He asked, “What are these two rivers, Gabriel?” He said, “These are the sources of the Nile and the Euphrates.” Then he proceeded through the heaven and came upon another river, above which was a palace of pearl and emerald. He struck his hand into it, and it was musk. He asked, “What is this, Gabriel?” He said, “This is al-Kawthar, which your Lord has kept for you.” Then he ascended to the second heaven. Its angels said to him what the angels of the first heaven had said: “Who is this?” He said, “Gabriel.” They said, “Who is with you?” He said, “Muhammad.” They said, “Has he been sent to him?” He said, “Yes.” They said, “Welcome to him.” Then he ascended with him to the third heaven, and they said what the first and second had said. Then he ascended with him to the fourth heaven, and they said the same. Then he ascended with him to the fifth heaven, and they said the same. Then he ascended with him to the sixth heaven, and they said the same. Then he ascended with him to the seventh heaven, and they said the same. In every heaven were Prophets whose names he mentioned. I remembered Idris in the second, Harun in the fourth, another in the fifth whose name I did not retain, Ibrahim in the sixth, and Musa in the seventh, because of the distinction of Allah’s speech to him. Musa said, “My Lord, I did not think anyone would be raised above me.” Then he ascended with him above that to a place known only to Allah, until he reached the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary. The Compeller, Lord of Might, drew near and came close, until he was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer. Allah revealed to him among what He revealed: “Fifty prayers for your community every day and night.” Then he descended until he reached Musa. Musa stopped him and asked, “O Muhammad, what did your Lord enjoin upon you?” He said, “He enjoined fifty prayers every day and night.” Musa said, “Your community cannot bear that. Go back, and ask your Lord to lighten it for you and them.” The Prophet turned toward Gabriel as though consulting him about it, and Gabriel indicated, “Yes, if you wish.” He took him up to the Compeller, and while he was in his place he said, “My Lord, lighten it for us, for my community cannot bear this.” He reduced ten prayers for him. Then he returned to Musa, who stopped him. Musa kept sending him back to his Lord until it became five prayers. Then Musa stopped him at the five and said, “O Muhammad, by Allah, I urged my people, the Children of Israel, to do less than this, but they were too weak and left it. Your community is weaker in bodies, hearts, physical strength, eyesight, and hearing, so go back and ask your Lord to lighten it for you.” Each time, the Prophet turned toward Gabriel for his advice, and Gabriel did not object. At the fifth time, he raised him and said, “My Lord, my community is weak in their bodies, hearts, hearing, and physical strength, so lighten it for us.” The Compeller said, “O Muhammad.” He replied, “At Your service and at Your pleasure.” He said, “The decree with Me is not changed. As I prescribed for you in the Mother of the Book, every good deed is multiplied tenfold. Thus it is fifty in the Mother of the Book, but five for you.” He returned to Musa, who asked, “What did you do?” He said, “He lightened it for us; He gives us ten times the reward for every good deed.” Musa said, “By Allah, I urged the Children of Israel to do less than that, but they left it. Go back to your Lord and ask Him to lighten it for you further.” The Messenger of Allah said, “Musa, by Allah, I am now too shy before my Lord, after repeatedly going back to Him.” He said, “Then descend in Allah’s name.” He said: He awoke while he was in the Sacred Mosque.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7518, book 97, باب كَلاَمِ الرَّبِّ مَعَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ لأَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ يَا أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُونَ لَبَّيْكَ رَبَّنَا وَسَعْدَيْكَ وَالْخَيْرُ فِي يَدَيْكَ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ هَلْ رَضِيتُمْ فَيَقُولُونَ وَمَا لَنَا لاَ نَرْضَى يَا رَبِّ وَقَدْ أَعْطَيْتَنَا مَا لَمْ تُعْطِ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ أَلاَ أُعْطِيكُمْ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُونَ يَا رَبِّ وَأَىُّ شَىْءٍ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَيَقُولُ أُحِلُّ عَلَيْكُمْ رِضْوَانِي فَلاَ أَسْخَطُ عَلَيْكُمْ بَعْدَهُ أَبَدًا ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Sulayman narrated to us: Ibn Wahb narrated to me: Malik narrated to me, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from Ata ibn Yasar, from Abu Sa‘id al-Khudri, who said: The Prophet said, “Allah will say to the people of Paradise, ‘O people of Paradise!’ They will say, ‘At Your service, our Lord, and at Your pleasure; all good is in Your hands.’ He will say, ‘Are you pleased?’ They will say, ‘Why would we not be pleased, our Lord, when You have given us what You have given no one else among Your creation?’ He will say, ‘Shall I not give you something better than that?’ They will say, ‘Our Lord, what could be better than that?’ He will say, ‘I bestow My pleasure upon you, and I will never be displeased with you after that.’”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7519, book 97, باب كَلاَمِ الرَّبِّ مَعَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ، حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِلاَلٌ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَوْمًا يُحَدِّثُ وَعِنْدَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْبَادِيَةِ ‏"‏ أَنَّ رَجُلاً مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ اسْتَأْذَنَ رَبَّهُ فِي الزَّرْعِ فَقَالَ أَوَ لَسْتَ فِيمَا شِئْتَ‏.‏ قَالَ بَلَى وَلَكِنِّي أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَزْرَعَ‏.‏ فَأَسْرَعَ وَبَذَرَ فَتَبَادَرَ الطَّرْفَ نَبَاتُهُ وَاسْتِوَاؤُهُ وَاسْتِحْصَادُهُ وَتَكْوِيرُهُ أَمْثَالَ الْجِبَالِ فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى دُونَكَ يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يُشْبِعُكَ شَىْءٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ الأَعْرَابِيُّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لاَ تَجِدُ هَذَا إِلاَّ قُرَشِيًّا أَوْ أَنْصَارِيًّا فَإِنَّهُمْ أَصْحَابُ زَرْعٍ، فَأَمَّا نَحْنُ فَلَسْنَا بِأَصْحَابِ زَرْعٍ‏.‏ فَضَحِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Sinan narrated to us: Fulayh narrated to us: Hilal narrated to us, from Ata ibn Yasar, from Abu Hurayrah, that one day the Prophet was speaking while a Bedouin was with him. He said, “A man among the people of Paradise will ask his Lord for permission to plant. He will say, ‘Are you not in whatever you wish?’ The man will say, ‘Yes, but I love to plant.’ He will sow quickly, and in the blink of an eye the plants will grow, stand upright, be harvested, and pile up like mountains. Allah Most High will say, ‘Here you are, son of Adam; nothing will satisfy you.’” The Bedouin said, “Messenger of Allah, you would find such a person only among Quraysh or the Ansar, for they are people of farming. We are not farmers.” The Messenger of Allah laughed.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7520, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏فَلاَ تَجْعَلُوا لِلَّهِ أَنْدَادًا‏}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُرَحْبِيلَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَىُّ الذَّنْبِ أَعْظَمُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ لِلَّهِ نِدًّا وَهْوَ خَلَقَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ إِنَّ ذَلِكَ لَعَظِيمٌ‏.‏ قُلْتُ ثُمَّ أَىّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ أَنْ تَقْتُلَ وَلَدَكَ تَخَافُ أَنْ يَطْعَمَ مَعَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ ثُمَّ أَىّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ أَنْ تُزَانِيَ بِحَلِيلَةِ جَارِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa‘id narrated to us: Jarir narrated to us, from Mansur, from Abu Wa’il, from Amr ibn Shurahbil, from Abdullah, who said: I asked the Prophet, “Which sin is greatest in Allah’s sight?” He said, “That you set up a rival to Allah when He created you.” I said, “That is indeed grave. Then which?” He said, “That you kill your child for fear that he will eat with you.” I said, “Then which?” He said, “That you commit adultery with your neighbor’s wife.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7521, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏وَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُونَ أَنْ يَشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلاَ أَبْصَارُكُمْ وَلاَ جُلُودُكُمْ وَلَكِنْ ظَنَنْتُمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَعْلَمُ كَثِيرًا مِمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ اجْتَمَعَ عِنْدَ الْبَيْتِ ثَقَفِيَّانِ وَقُرَشِيٌّ، أَوْ قُرَشِيَّانِ وَثَقَفِيٌّ، كَثِيرَةٌ شَحْمُ بُطُونِهِمْ قَلِيلَةٌ فِقْهُ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمْ أَتَرَوْنَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَسْمَعُ مَا نَقُولُ قَالَ الآخَرُ يَسْمَعُ إِنْ جَهَرْنَا وَلاَ يَسْمَعُ إِنْ أَخْفَيْنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُ إِنْ كَانَ يَسْمَعُ إِذَا جَهَرْنَا فَإِنَّهُ يَسْمَعُ إِذَا أَخْفَيْنَا‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏[quran sura="41" aya_start="22" aya_end="22"]{‏وَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُونَ أَنْ يَشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلاَ أَبْصَارُكُمْ وَلاَ جُلُودُكُمْ‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏
en_text: Al-Humaydi narrated to us: Sufyan narrated to us: Mansur narrated to us, from Mujahid, from Abu Ma‘mar, from Abdullah, who said: Two men from Thaqif and one Qurashi—or two Qurashis and one man from Thaqif—whose bellies were very fat and whose hearts had little understanding, gathered near the House. One said, “Do you think Allah hears what we say?” Another said, “He hears us if we speak aloud, but not if we speak quietly.” The other said, “If He hears us when we speak aloud, then He hears us when we speak quietly too.” Then Allah Most High revealed, “You did not conceal yourselves lest your hearing, your sight, and your skins testify against you…” Quran 41:22.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7522, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأْنٍ‏} ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ وَرْدَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَيْفَ تَسْأَلُونَ أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ عَنْ كُتُبِهِمْ وَعِنْدَكُمْ كِتَابُ اللَّهِ أَقْرَبُ الْكُتُبِ عَهْدًا بِاللَّهِ، تَقْرَءُونَهُ مَحْضًا لَمْ يُشَبْ
en_text: Ali ibn Abdullah narrated to us: Hatim ibn Wardan narrated to us: Ayyub narrated to us, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas, who said: “How can you ask the People of the Book about their scriptures when you have Allah’s Book with you, the most recent book from Allah? You read it pure, unmixed.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7523, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأْنٍ‏} ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ يَا مَعْشَرَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ كَيْفَ تَسْأَلُونَ أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ عَنْ شَىْءٍ وَكِتَابُكُمُ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَى نَبِيِّكُمْ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحْدَثُ الأَخْبَارِ بِاللَّهِ مَحْضًا لَمْ يُشَبْ وَقَدْ حَدَّثَكُمُ اللَّهُ أَنَّ أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ قَدْ بَدَّلُوا مِنْ كُتُبِ اللَّهِ وَغَيَّرُوا فَكَتَبُوا بِأَيْدِيهِمْ، قَالُوا هُوَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ‏.‏ لِيَشْتَرُوا بِذَلِكَ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلاً، أَوَ لاَ يَنْهَاكُمْ مَا جَاءَكُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ عَنْ مَسْأَلَتِهِمْ، فَلاَ وَاللَّهِ مَا رَأَيْنَا رَجُلاً مِنْهُمْ يَسْأَلُكُمْ عَنِ الَّذِي أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ‏.‏
en_text: Abu al-Yaman informed us: Shu‘ayb informed us, from al-Zuhri: Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah informed me that Abdullah ibn Abbas said: “O community of Muslims, how can you ask the People of the Book about something when the Book Allah sent down to your Prophet is the most recent report from Allah, pure and unmixed? Allah has told you that the People of the Book altered what was in Allah’s Books and changed them, writing with their own hands and saying, ‘This is from Allah,’ in order to gain a small price. Does not the knowledge that has come to you prevent you from asking them? By Allah, we have never seen one of them ask you about what was sent down to you.”
